##### Project general facts

Divine Residencia is a thoughtfully designed residential development in the heart of Dubai Studio City, created to promote a balanced lifestyle centered around family, wellness, work, and nature. The project offers an elegant collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments that combine contemporary architecture with functional living spaces. Surrounded by a vibrant, family-friendly community, Divine Residencia seamlessly blends modern comfort with peaceful surroundings, creating an ideal environment for everyday living.

Residents enjoy a lifestyle focused on well-being and convenience, with amenities designed to encourage both relaxation and productivity. Beautifully landscaped areas, dedicated study spaces, and thoughtfully planned communal facilities create an environment where work, leisure, and family life exist in perfect harmony. Excellent connectivity to Dubai's major highways, business districts, schools, and entertainment destinations further enhances the appeal of this well-positioned community.

The residences are finished with premium-quality materials and contemporary interiors designed to maximize natural light, fresh air, and a sense of openness. Spacious layouts, refined finishes, and carefully selected design elements create bright and comfortable living spaces inspired by nature. Kitchens come fully equipped with built-in appliances, offering both style and everyday functionality. The residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors according to their own taste and lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Studio City is a dynamic and thriving community located in the heart of Dubai. As a specialized zone dedicated to the media and entertainment industry, it offers a unique and vibrant living experience for residents. Designed to nurture creativity and innovation, Dubai Studio City is a hub for professionals and enthusiasts in the fields of film, broadcasting, music, and other creative disciplines.

The community of Dubai Studio City is meticulously planned to provide a conducive environment for the media and entertainment industry. It is home to state-of-the-art production studios, soundstages, and post-production facilities, attracting renowned local and international companies. The presence of these industry leaders creates a stimulating and inspiring atmosphere, fostering collaboration and growth within the creative community.

Dubai Studio City is not only a place of work and residence but also a center for entertainment and leisure. The community features a range of retail outlets, restaurants, and cafes, providing residents with a variety of dining and shopping options. Additionally, there are recreational facilities, parks, and open spaces where residents can relax, exercise, and enjoy quality time with family and friends.
